title: Government reforms of Alexander II of Russia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Government reforms of Alexander II of Russia", at revision 1379613425, opens: "The government reforms imposed by Tsar Alexander II of Russia, often called the Great Reforms by historians, were a series of major social, political, legal and governmental reforms in the Russian Empire carried out in the 1860s." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4393846, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "The Government reforms imposed by Tsar Alexander II of Russia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
